rationale: Dated master licence-register PDF: mine once per release to seed the Kosovo bank/PSP actor map; the parent index is the monitored surface.
Durable landing page from which rotating licence-list PDFs hang — the stable monitoring anchor for licence changes.
Licensing-procedure sub-page of bqk-kos.org; interpretive value only, covered by monitoring the supervision section.
Recurring CBK annual report series page — canonical yearly banking and payment-system aggregates.
One dated Financial Stability Report PDF: rich evidence, but the publications index is the producing source.
Serbian-locale mirror of the CBK publications tree; url_verification failed, re-check liveness before deciding.
CBK publications hub carrying the quarterly financial-system assessment — highest-value recurring analytical cadence.
Monthly statistical bulletin series since 2001 — backbone high-frequency numeric baseline for Kosovo banking.
Monthly financial-system information report is a genuine standalone stream; URL check failed, verify liveness in the browser pass.
Downloadable time-series tables (balance sheets, rates, deposits/loans) — the structured data spine of the cell.
Single monthly data-release news post; covered by monitoring the CBK newsroom feed with a slug trigger.
Payment-systems statistics index: card, ATM/POS, e-banking and wallet volumes — core payments disclosure surface.
One-off card-usage study PDF with terminal-count and instrument-mix benchmarks; strong evidence, not a recurring feed.
Payment-system oversight sub-page of the CBK payments section; maps SPN/SEKN infrastructure but adds no standalone stream.
National Retail Payments Strategy PDF — a single forward-looking policy artifact signalling procurement direction.
Standalone regulation PDF on authorisation/governance of payment and e-money institutions — regulatory core, static document.
Payment Systems Law PDF: fixed primary statute used to anchor citation chains, not a monitored surface.
Official Gazette act page for the CBK constitutive law; single legal artifact establishing the disclosure obligation.
Draft Payment Services Law PDF — early-warning artifact on PSP licensing regime change; legal status public government publication.
CBK price-comparison web app with per-institution rates and fees across ~50 institutions — unique structured pricing intelligence.
Regulator newsroom: licences, enforcement, data releases — highest-frequency trigger layer for re-crawling slower sources.
Board-decisions register is the earliest record of licensing/regulatory change; URL check failed, confirm the live path (likely /en locale).
CBK's own audited IFRS statements, recurring monthly/quarterly — useful context, secondary to sector aggregates.
CBK research/working-paper index — recurring methodology and granular banking/payments studies.
Financial-education FAQ sub-site; glossary value only, duplicate register copies, and the URL check failed.
Static org-structure page for supervision departments; no signal production, fully covered by the parent domain.
Primary IR/disclosure hub of a systemic Kosovo bank with 2010-2025 annual and ESG reports in sq/en.
Rare Kosovo bank publishing quarterly plus annual reports and a WAIR rate index — best bank-own high-frequency channel.
